body: v0.10.46 is cut on cf39b90ba (the #580 merge, task 21631d8d: the win-arm64 release asset). Release run 36042223548 is green and the release carries FIVE assets from this tag on: checksums.txt, linux-x64, osx-arm64, win-arm64, win-x64. Please update with a plain h9k update --restart at your next lull; there is no schema change over v0.10.45. Two things to pass along. First, from this cut the post-cuts gate is five assets, not four: if you keep a copy of that rule, change it. Second, for the ARM64 colleague: their source-built h9k carries the old platform map and will refuse h9k update, so their first release install is scripts/install.ps1 (the iwr | iex one-liner in docs/INSTALL.md) or one more h9k install --repo from a checkout at or after cf39b90ba; every h9k update after that fetches hall9k-win-arm64.zip on its own. Brian's own Parallels ARM64 VM confirmed the script's probe: machine-scope PROCESSOR_ARCHITECTURE reads ARM64 under both PowerShell 7.6.5 and Windows PowerShell 5.1, and 5.1 prints nothing for RuntimeInformation.OSArchitecture. Also still owed on your side when convenient: the dead run 01a0c1c1 is still to clear.
